generated_assets.prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural
Asset type: local photo-style image for a Chinese speaking-class slide, one of four small activity options
Primary request: A natural candid documentary-style photograph of three Vietnamese university-age friends taking a relaxed walk and chatting together in a modest public park in Vinh, Vietnam. Make the outdoor park walk unmistakable so students can compare it with indoor hotpot, milk tea, and karaoke choices.
Scene/backdrop: a simple paved park path with tropical greenery and a few trees, plausible everyday Vinh city setting, no famous landmarks.
Subject: three casually dressed university-age Vietnamese friends walking side by side, friendly and relaxed, full figures visible at a moderate distance.
Composition: horizontal landscape crop, balanced group near center, clear readable scene when displayed as a small card beside other lifestyle photos.
Lighting and style: natural early-evening daylight, realistic colors, editorial lifestyle photography consistent with ordinary candid activity photos.
Avoid: any text, logos, signs with legible writing, watermarks, staged advertising, exaggerated cinematic lighting, identifiable real people.
